label: Timer Boundary Event
description: A deadline on a task. Fires if the work is not done in time, either cancelling it or raising a reminder alongside it.

timeDuration.label: Duration
timeDuration.description: How long the task may stay open before the event fires, as a duration such as P5D (5 days) or PT2H (2 hours).

cancelActivity.label: Cancel the task
cancelActivity.description: Whether the task stops when this fires (yes), or carries on while a separate path also starts (no). Default: yes.

performers.label: Performers
performers.description: The people or groups who may trigger this deadline by hand. If none are chosen, only the automatic timer can.
